title: rinorea lankawiensis
intro: Rinorea lankawiensis, commonly known as the Lankawi cliff vine or Lankawi island vine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Violaceae. It is a climbing vine native to the island of Penang in Malaysia, and is known for its medicinal properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Rinorea lankawiensis include its potential to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and microbial infections, making it a valuable resource for the development of new medicinal compounds.
